items.title: Finite etale tilting equivalence for multivariate perfectoid Delta fields
items.author: Aprameyo Pal; Rohit Pokhrel
items.difficulty_reason: The multivariate tilting equivalence requires the geometry of completed tensor products of perfectoid fields (including their non-field prime structure), modified non-Archimedean functional analysis, almost algebras, perfectoid rational localizations and integral Tate acyclicity, ending in an almost-purity argument. Original Delta-field and coefficient setup, all author constructions and geometric diagram retained; the earlier open-mapping support result is not recounted.

primary.label: complete original main finite-etale tilting equivalence and full almost-integral chain
